plainTranslation: Energies that spark and cooperate. Easy physical chemistry and a knack for getting things done together. Failure mode: underusing the momentum. Take on a project or a goal together - this contact likes action.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Your drives cooperate and spur each other. You get things done together. Take on the ambitious thing as a team.
tension: A pattern to watch for is assuming that because the connection feels easy, it will take care of itself. You may both agree on what you want, see the opportunity in front of you, and still keep putting off the first step. Not because you lack motivation, but because neither of you feels enough pressure to act right away.
advice: The growth here comes from being intentional. Momentum builds when someone decides to start instead of waiting to feel ready. The more you support each other's goals, follow through on plans, and turn ideas into action, the stronger this dynamic becomes. What looks like potential on paper becomes real progress when one of you is willing to get the ball rolling.
summaryShort: Your drives cooperate and spur each other.
